The calibration recording is the stretch on which bad channels, ICA and ICLabel of the causal preprocessing were fitted (01_preprocessing/causal/healthy/plan.csv and patient/plan.csv, column cut_export_s). Every trial, scored or not, trains the decoder: fold map, training and decoded outputs do not depend on the mask.
